text.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 发布与核心特性
text.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro Release and Core Features

text.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 是科基新K3.1系列首款模型，定位为目前最强的3T级开源权重模型，上下文窗口达到100万token。其基于K3后训练，通过扩展后训练计算并优化RL框架、长上下文推理和沙箱基础设施，在编码、3D创建和金融研究等多领域实现稳定提升。
text.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro is the first model in Kimi's new K3.1 series and the most capable 3T-class open-weight model to date, featuring a 1-million-token context window. Building on K3 with expanded post-training compute and optimized RL framework, long-context inference, and sandbox infrastructure, it delivers stable gains across coding, 3D creation, and financial research.

text.zh: 此外，Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed版本提供2-3倍的推理速度，适用于实时交互场景。模型现已在Kimi.ai、Kimi Work、Kimi Code和Kimi API开放使用，完整权重将于2026年11月4日发布。
text.en: The Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed version offers 2-3 times the inference speed for responsive interactions. The model is available today on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API, with full model weights releasing by November 4, 2026.

text.zh: 多领域基准表现与实际应用
text.en: Multi-Domain Benchmark Performance and Real-World Applications

text.zh: 在编码基准上，K3.1 Pro的Terminal-Bench 4.0分数达65.7%，领先GPT-6 Astra的58.2%，仅次于Claude Opus 5.5的66.4%。其在Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon上的61.2%也优于前代K3的55.95%。K3.1 Pro可处理真实代码库的快速修复和完整项目构建，支持Unity、Unreal Engine和Godot等引擎的3D游戏与Web体验创建。
text.en: On coding benchmarks, K3.1 Pro scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%). Its 61.2% on Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon exceeds K3's 55.95%. The model handles quick fixes in real codebases, full project builds, and creates complete 3D experiences using engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot.

text.zh: 在3D建模领域，BenchCAD分数92.7%（使用工具时），接近Claude Opus 5.5的96.2%和GPT-6 Astra的95.9%。K3.1 Pro擅长从文本、草图或图像推断空间关系，构建可打印3D模型，并通过Blender和CAD脚本编辑资产库。
text.en: On 3D modeling, it scores 92.7% on BenchCAD (with tools), approaching Claude Opus 5.5 (96.2%) and GPT-6 Astra (95.9%). The model infers shapes, proportions, and spatial relationships from text, sketches, or images to build printable 3D models, editing asset libraries via Blender and CAD scripts.

text.zh: 在金融研究方面，OfficeQA Pro v2分数64.4%，Frontier Finance和内部金融基准（金融建模+7.2分、金融研究+11.6分、业务操作+4.2倍K3）均实现显著提升。针对事实准确性，Kimi Hallu Bench Hard上的幻觉率从K3的23.4%降至8.3%，源自研究能被审计。
text.en: In financial research, it scores 64.4% on OfficeQA Pro v2, with significant improvements on Frontier Finance and internal benchmarks (Financial Modeling +7.2 points, Financial Research +11.6 points, Business Operation +4.2× K3). Targeted factual accuracy improvements reduce hallucination rate on Kimi Hallu Bench Hard from 23.4% (K3) to 8.3%, enabling auditable research.

text.zh: K3.1 Pro通过数据清洗和RL控制，xdev-bench-hard基准上攻击成功率从90.5%降至81%，仍保持比前代更强的通用编码能力。但其网络安全能力低于已公开三月的顶级闭源模型，属于设计上的妥协。完全权重将于11月4日开放，供组织启用。
text.en: Through data cleaning and RL controls, K3.1 Pro's pass rate on xdev-bench-hard drops from 90.5% to 81%, while general coding capability remains stronger than its predecessor. However, its offensive cyber capability is below that of proprietary models publicly available for at least three months, by design. Full weights release November 4, 2026 for organizational enablement.
